id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0917-20261001 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T14:06:29Z"
severity: MINOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex
queue_ref: Q-921  # queue issue_ref ISS-0921 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0950
github_ref: GH-2095
status: open

task.description:
WF-03 Step 4 REGRESSION TESTS. Implement the design's test matrix (lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md, test-matrix section: 22 rejected + 10 accepted URL classes at register, publish and HTTP 422 levels, R-MISSING per write path, P-ABSENT good/bad stored URL, unchanged-republish of legacy bad URL, publish-rollback of the archive insert, templated-host rejection, U-NODNS (a)+(b), validate_syntactic/1 unit tests, and a test that validate/1,2 and the dispatch gate still reject the same URLs). Place tests in the existing relevant test files or new files following repo conventions (check test/letflow/webhooks url_validator test, service_catalog_test.exs, admin_services route tests, e.g. via Glob). Branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001 in the main checkout; do NOT switch branches. FAIL-FIRST PROOF (mandatory, WF-03 section 'When the pre-fix failure is the code under test does not exist'): (1) in a THROWAWAY git worktree outside the repo (git worktree add <scratchpad>/wt-pre origin/main, copy only the new/changed test files in; share deps/_build via copy or symlink only if safe, else compile there -- machine is shared so be modest), run the new tests and record which fail pre-fix (expect register/publish-acceptance and validate_syntactic undefined failures) with real counts; (2) MUTANTS applied ONLY in throwaway worktrees of the branch, never in the main checkout, targeting the specific traps: m1 accept http scheme; m2 drop the private/loopback blocklist for syntactic path; m3 allow {{ }} in host part; m4 use validate_change instead of get_field (skips unchanged republish); m5 check only insert_changeset not publish_changeset; m6 resolve DNS (call resolver) in validate_syntactic; m7 treat absent key on publish as skip. Record for each mutant the pass/fail counts and which tests fail; every mutant must be killed by at least one test, else add tests. Remove all worktrees when done (git worktree remove --force; git worktree prune) and verify git worktree list shows only the main checkout. Then in the main checkout run the scoped files: MIX_ENV=test mix test <your test files> plus test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs and quote real output (6 pre-existing tenant_template_build failures in service_catalog_test.exs AC6/AC7 are environmental -- confirm they are the only failures). Machine is shared: NO full suite. Do not commit (ORCH commits). Complete the handoff PASS/FAIL per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md (spec: list of tests per acceptance item; verify git status --porcelain lib/ is empty at the end -- you must not change lib/).

REWORK ITERATION 1 (TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAIL, see step-04b-test-design-validator.json): R-LEN row is vacuous: the over-length URL in test/letflow/service_catalog/endpoint_url_validation_test.exs ~181-190 is otherwise valid, so removing the 'field already has an error' de-duplication clause in Entry leaves the test green (surviving mutant, 70/70). Make the over-length URL also statically bad (e.g. http://example.test/ padded to 2049 chars), assert EXACTLY ONE :endpoint_url error with validation: :length (for register; add the same for publish), and re-prove in a throwaway worktree that removing the de-dup clause now fails the test (record counts). Everything else passed. Same constraints as before: no branch switching/checkout in the main checkout, no commit, no full suite. On finishing, flip status to COMPLETED/FAILED as normal (do not leave IN_PROGRESS).
